sub.title: Submissions
sub.question: Which applications are stuck between ready and received?
sub.honest: Hangyul never stores portal passwords and never submits on its own. Evidence (a reference number or receipt) is what moves an application to “received”.

def.issue: A failed attempt is recorded (portal error, payment declined…) and nothing has been submitted since.
def.confirmation_missing: Handed off or reported submitted more than 2 days ago, and still no reference number or receipt. Ask for it.
def.authorized: The student authorized the agency to submit (recorded legal basis). Submit on the official portal and record the reference.
def.ready: Ready and nothing recorded yet: do the final check and hand it off (the student submits on the official portal).
def.needs_final_review: Every required item is ready, but the application is not marked Ready yet: the final review is next.
def.submitted: Handed off or reported submitted in the last 2 days; waiting for the reference or receipt.
def.received: Evidence is recorded and the application is with the university.

ops.backlog: Open work at the end of each week: team tasks (not the student's own to-dos) not yet done, document versions not yet reviewed, and essays submitted for review and not yet reviewed (current review round).
ops.ageing: Days since the case last moved: the latest of a pipeline stage change, an application status change or the assignment to this agency.
ops.load: Weighted load per person: each kind of open work they hold × its weight (the agency's weight table), against their personal capacity in the same points. Overloaded = load above capacity. People on leave are not assigned new work.
ops.sla: First reply not given by its due time; documents waiting for review longer than 48 hours; essay reviews past the promised review time.
ops.deadlines: Applications not yet submitted whose deadline is within 14 days and that still miss required items.
ops.stages: Median days an application stayed in a status before moving on (stays that ended in the last 365 days). Withheld below {{n}} stays.
ops.blocked: A case is blocked when it waits on someone (any party except nobody) and has not moved for more than 14 days. Oldest first.
ops.unassigned_paid: Paid for a Hangyul service, and no counselor owns the case (or, for Hangyul, no agency is assigned yet).

svc.completion: Completed ÷ cases created in the period (cancelled excluded)
svc.sla: Cases where the team acted after the SLA (or has not acted and the SLA passed) ÷ cases whose SLA has come due
svc.arrival: Airport pickups completed ÷ pickups whose arrival time has passed (cancelled excluded)
svc.resolution: Median hours from request to completion, completed cases only
